name: Rune of Nesting
summary: At Ban'ethil Barrow Den, the Rune of Nesting lies among four sacred relics. It helps Athridas Bearmantle prepare the ritual that safely awakens the Druids of the Talon from the Emerald Dream.

sections.title: A Sacred Focus for Awakening
sections.body: The Rune of Nesting lies in the Chest of Nesting, deep in the winding chambers of Ban'ethil Barrow Den. Night elf druids hibernate in underground barrow dens to commune with nature through the Emerald Dream. To return safely, the Druids of the Talon need a precise awakening ritual guided by sacred relics. The rune is one of four: the Raven Claw Talisman, the Black Feather Quill, the Sapphire of Sky, and the Rune of Nesting. Together, the relics help call the sleeping druids back to the waking world.

sections.title: Crisis in Ban'ethil
sections.body: Corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs have overrun Ban'ethil Barrow Den, putting its sleeping defenders in peril. Without the relics, the druids risk remaining trapped in the Emerald Dream while invaders desecrate their sanctuary. Recovering the Rune of Nesting and its companion artifacts allows Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar to prepare the ritual that can safely awaken them.

faq.q: What is the Rune of Nesting used for?
aliases: what does rune of nesting do
faq.answer: Athridas Bearmantle requires the Rune of Nesting to conduct the ritual that safely rouses the Druids of the Talon from their deep slumber in the Emerald Dream. It is one of the four Relics of Wakening used in that ritual.

faq.q: Where is the Rune of Nesting found?
faq.answer: The Rune of Nesting is stored in the Chest of Nesting, in the subterranean tunnels of Ban'ethil Barrow Den, west of Dolanaar on Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why can't the sleeping druids simply wake up on their own?
aliases: why do druids need waking ritual
faq.answer: The druids enter a delicate, trance-like state when they hibernate in the Emerald Dream. Without sacred relics and an awakening ritual, they may be unable to return, leaving their minds adrift and their bodies exposed to danger.

faq.q: What other relics are needed alongside the Rune of Nesting?
faq.answer: The ritual requires four Relics of Wakening: the Rune of Nesting, the Raven Claw Talisman, the Black Feather Quill, and the Sapphire of Sky.

angles.text: As a druid, the Rune of Nesting speaks to the sacred rituals of the Cenarion Circle and the danger sleeping brethren face when their sanctuaries are breached.
As a night elf, the loss of wakening relics and the desecration of barrow dens reflect the growing corruption among Teldrassil's wildlife and furbolgs.
